title: Run Anth.us editorial fully through Papyrus, Gatsby stays the renderer
description: Make the Papyrus newsroom the only authoring path: every story starts on the ANTH board, drafts go through Limatus diagnose and verify, and a human approval on the board publishes. Papyrus commits to the content submodule and pins the revision; the site repo stays the renderer and Amplify deploys as today. Keep this a process-plus-glue change, not a site rebuild. Run it as a public factory project from day one so its board history becomes the record the Papyrus newsroom article (ANTH-6360c2) is written from.
